title: quadratic intersection
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate quadratic cell IntersectWithLine methods for various cell types.

**dataset → input → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBiQuadraticQuad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBiQuadraticQuad.html) — bi quadratic quad.
- [vtkBiQuadraticQuadraticHexahedron](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBiQuadraticQuadraticHexahedron.html) — bi quadratic quadratic hexahedron.
- [vtkBiQuadraticQuadraticWedge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBiQuadraticQuadraticWedge.html) — bi quadratic quadratic wedge.
- [vtkBiQuadraticTriangle](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBiQuadraticTriangle.html) — bi quadratic triangle.
- [vtkCellArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellArray.html) — cell array.
- [vtkCubicLine](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCubicLine.html) — cubic line.
- [vtkMinimalStandardRandomSequence](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMinimalStandardRandomSequence.html) — minimal standard random sequence.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkQuadraticEdge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticEdge.html) — quadratic edge.
- [vtkQuadraticHexahedron](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticHexahedron.html) — quadratic hexahedron.
- [vtkQuadraticLinearQuad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticLinearQuad.html) — quadratic linear quad.
- [vtkQuadraticLinearWedge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticLinearWedge.html) — quadratic linear wedge.
- [vtkQuadraticPyramid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticPyramid.html) — quadratic pyramid.
- [vtkQuadraticQuad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticQuad.html) — quadratic quad.
- [vtkQuadraticTetra](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticTetra.html) — quadratic tetra.
- [vtkQuadraticTriangle](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticTriangle.html) — quadratic triangle.
- [vtkQuadraticWedge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkQuadraticWedge.html) — quadratic wedge.
- [vtkTriQuadraticHexahedron](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriQuadraticHexahedron.html) — tri quadratic hexahedron.
- [vtkTriQuadraticPyramid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriQuadraticPyramid.html) — tri quadratic pyramid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
